note: Request side of the proposal schema: what a client asks for in an RFP. The extraction prompt, output validation and review form all derive from this file.

fields.name: client_name
fields.label: Client
fields.hint: The organisation issuing the RFP and appointing the consultant, as written. In a message the client is often named in the sender's label ('Karim – Marina Crest') or the text ('Marina Crest again', 'Oasis Living here'); in call or meeting notes it is the organisation the call was with. A person's name alone is not a client.

fields.name: project_name
fields.label: Project
fields.hint: The project's own name ('Al Waha Residences', 'Straits Tower'). Never the client's name.

fields.name: request_type
fields.label: Kind of ask
fields.hint: proposal if the client wants a fee proposal for an appointment; feasibility_estimate if they only want a rough number or budget figure and say no appointment is intended yet ('just trying to understand budgets', 'not decided whether to proceed', 'rough number for our feasibility'). A request for a 'rough fee', 'quick number' or 'number by Friday' is still a proposal unless the client says no appointment is intended. Record it only when the wording shows which.

fields.name: reference_project
fields.label: Like a past project
fields.hint: A past project of this practice the client names as the model for this one ('similar to Bay Square', 'same scope as Oasis Gardens'), as written.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.hint: Country where the project is built (not the client's or the practice's office), even if it is not one of the practice's markets.

fields.name: city
fields.label: City
fields.hint: City where the project is built. A district or neighbourhood counts as its city (JVC, Business Bay: Dubai; Hinjewadi: Pune; Thao Dien: Ho Chi Minh City; Parramatta: Sydney).

fields.name: typology
fields.label: Typology
fields.hint: Primary building use of the project. For a project that is mainly a masterplan of a district or large site, use masterplan; a resort that includes a masterplan is still hospitality.

fields.name: gfa_m2
fields.label: GFA / BUA
fields.hint: Total gross floor area or built-up area (BUA) of the buildings in this appointment. Not component sub-areas, not areas stated as excluded from GFA (e.g. basement parking), not areas of other phases or existing buildings.

fields.name: site_area_m2
fields.label: Site area
fields.hint: Site or plot area.

fields.name: fitout_area_m2
fields.label: Interior design area
fields.hint: Area covered by the interior design / fit-out scope.

fields.name: landscape_area_m2
fields.label: Landscape area
fields.hint: Area covered by the landscape scope.

fields.name: storeys
fields.label: Storeys
fields.hint: Floors above ground of the main building, if stated (G+20 is 21, '~30 floors' is 30).

fields.name: quality_tier
fields.label: Quality tier
fields.hint: The quality or specification level the client states: luxury (5-star, ultra-luxury, branded), high (4-star, high-end, premium, Grade A), mid (3-star, mid-market), low (budget, affordable, budget conscious).

fields.name: services
fields.label: Services
fields.hint: Design services the client asks this consultant to provide. One mention per service. Never include services the client says it will appoint others for (engineering, local architect of record, etc.). A request for design stages of a building that names no discipline ('concept for a resi tower', 'feasibility study and concept design') is architecture; 'arch' is architecture and 'ID' is interior design.

fields.name: stage_package
fields.label: Stages
fields.hint: Design stages this consultant must deliver. One mention per stage, with the stage name exactly as written. Never include stages done by others. 'Just feasibility' or a 'feasibility study' is the feasibility stage; 'concept to DD' is concept, schematic design and design development.

fields.name: excluded_scope
fields.label: Excluded / by others
fields.hint: Each service or stage explicitly stated as not part of this appointment or done by others.

fields.name: special_requests
fields.label: Special requests
fields.hint: Each requirement outside a standard design appointment that could change scope or price (extra deliverables, certification support, unlimited revisions, specialist design, negotiation support).

fields.name: submission_deadline
fields.label: Submission deadline
fields.hint: Deadline for submitting the proposal, with time and time zone if stated.

fields.name: liability_cap
fields.label: Liability
fields.hint: Whether the client's terms cap the consultant's liability (capped) or make it unlimited (uncapped).

fields.name: payment_terms_days
fields.label: Payment terms (days)
fields.hint: Days within which the client pays invoices.
